title: O happy day that fixed my choice
lyrics: [F]O happy day that fixed my choice
On Thee, my[C] Savior and my[F] God!
[F]He taught me how to watch and pray,
I am my Lord's, and [C]He is [F]mine;
[F]He drew me and I followed on,
Fixed on this blissful[C] center,[F] rest;
[F]Here have I found a nobler part,
Here heav'nly pleasures[C] fill my[F] breast.
[F]High heav'n that hears the solemn vow,
[F]Till in life's latest hour I bow,
And bless, in death, a[C] bond so[F] dear.
